# System Architecture

| Component | Module | Role |
|-----------|--------|------|
| IterativeTDDRunner | src/agents/iterative_tdd_runner.py | Orchestrates the overall iterative TDD loop (plan → RED → GREEN → REFACTOR → repeat) |
| IncrementalPlanner | src/agents/incremental_planner.py | LLM-driven planner that decides the next single test to write |
| TDDCycleRunner | src/agents/tdd_cycle_runner.py | Runs one complete TDD cycle (RED → GREEN → REFACTOR) with retry and learning |
| PythonLanguagePod | src/agents/python_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Python: delegates code generation to WorkerAgent, execution to PodmanOrchestrator |
| GoLanguagePod | src/agents/go_language_pod.py | LanguagePod implementation for Go TDD cycles |
| TypeScriptLanguagePod | src/agents/typescript_language_pod.py | LanguagePod for TypeScript TDD cycles via vitest in Podman container |
| SimulationPod | src/agents/simulation_pod.py | LanguagePod for PyBullet physics simulation TDD cycles |
| WorkerAgent | src/agents/worker_agent.py | Python code generation agent: builds prompts and extracts code for RED, GREEN, REFACTOR phases |
| TypeScriptWorkerAgent | src/agents/typescript_worker_agent.py | TypeScript code generation agent for TDD cycles |
| PodmanOrchestrator | src/agents/podman_orchestrator.py | Stateless sidecar execution layer; sends files to container and verifies integrity (hash chain) |
| PodmanRunner | src/agents/podman_runner.py | Manages rootless Podman container lifecycle and sends pulse executions |
| PlaybookManager | src/playbook/manager.py | Core playbook CRUD: creation, bullet addition, delta updates, deduplication, persistence |
| ExperimentLogger | src/storage/experiment_logger.py | Logs TDD cycles and ML experiments to PostgreSQL or SQLite fallback |
| Reflector | src/core/reflector/module.py | Analyzes task outcome and extracts error patterns, root causes, and key insights |
| Curator | src/core/curator/module.py | Synthesizes reflector insights into playbook delta bullets |
| Generator | src/core/generator/module.py | Executes tasks using playbook-guided LLM; retrieves relevant bullets and generates solutions |
| BulletRetriever | src/playbook/retrieval.py | Hybrid retrieval (semantic + keyword) for selecting relevant playbook bullets |
| AdaptiveBroker | src/broker/adaptive_broker.py | Routes tasks to best-performing agent based on historical metrics |
| PerformanceAggregator | src/broker/performance_aggregator.py | Aggregates agent performance metrics from audit trail for routing |
| CapabilityRegistry | src/broker/capability_registry.py | Anonymous registry of agent capabilities and proficiency ratings |
| DistillationRouter | src/playbook/distillation_router.py | Routes tasks to domain-specific distillation playbooks with provenance-aware filtering |
| ContextGraphRetriever | src/retrieval/cgr3_retriever.py | CGR³ retriever: context-aware bullet ranking with verdict (APPLY/ASK/SKIP) |
| InstitutionalKnowledgeService | src/retrieval/service.py | Central knowledge retrieval service for code generation activities |
| ContractArchitect | src/contracts/contract_architect.py | Generates interface contracts from natural language requirements |
| ContractDecomposer | src/contracts/contract_decomposer.py | Decomposes user requirements into structured interface contracts |
| ContractOrchestrator | src/contracts/contract_driven.py | Orchestrates contract-driven development: registration, validation, status tracking |
| ModuleArchitect | src/contracts/module_architect.py | Generates module-level contracts for stateful systems with dependency analysis |
| ModuleTDDBuilder | src/contracts/module_tdd_builder.py | Builds individual module implementations using TDD methodology |
| ProjectArchitect | src/contracts/project_architect.py | Decomposes project specification into a module dependency DAG |
| ProjectBuilder | src/cli/project_builder.py | Drives ModuleArchitect and ModuleTDDBuilder over a full ProjectPlan |
| EnsembleBuildRunner | src/agents/ensemble_build.py | Drives multi-candidate blind evaluation for feature builds |
| ConsensusBuilder | src/ensemble/consensus.py | Builds consensus from multiple model proposals via clustering and merging |
| GherkinFeatureBridge | src/agents/gherkin_feature_bridge.py | Parses Gherkin .feature files into FeatureSpec for TDD planning |
| GherkinExtractionAgent | src/agents/gherkin_extraction_agent.py | Reverse-engineers Gherkin scenarios from existing code and tests |

```mermaid
sequenceDiagram
    participant Runner as IterativeTDDRunner
    participant Planner as IncrementalPlanner
    participant Cycle as TDDCycleRunner
    participant Pod as PythonLanguagePod
    participant Worker as WorkerAgent
    participant Orchestrator as PodmanOrchestrator
    participant Container as PodmanRunner
    participant Logger as ExperimentLogger
    participant Reflector
    participant Curator
    participant Playbook as PlaybookManager

    Runner->>Planner: next_increment(requirement, cycle)
    Planner-->>Runner: TestIncrement
    Runner->>Cycle: run(spec)
    Cycle->>Pod: run_red(spec)
    Pod->>Worker: generate_test(spec)
    Worker-->>Pod: test_code
    Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test_file: code})
    Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse(files)
    Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
    Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult

    alt RED aborted or never_pulsed
        Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult(error)
    else RED passed (test correctly fails)
        loop max_green_attempts times
            Cycle->>Pod: run_green(retry_spec)
            Pod->>Worker: generate_implementation(spec)
            Worker-->>Pod: impl_code
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test, impl})
            Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse
            Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
            alt GREEN passed
                break
            else GREEN failed and not abort
                Note right of Cycle: error_feedback set for retry
            end
        end
        alt GREEN passed
            Cycle->>Pod: run_refactor(spec)
            Pod->>Worker: generate_refactor(spec)
            Worker-->>Pod: refactored_code
            Pod->>Orchestrator: pulse({test, refactored})
            Orchestrator->>Container: send_pulse
            Container-->>Orchestrator: PhaseResult
            Orchestrator-->>Pod: PhaseResult
        end
    end

    alt cycle successful or stagnant GREEN failure
        Cycle->>Reflector: reflect(task, gen_output, env_feedback)
        Reflector-->>Cycle: ReflectorOutput
        Cycle->>Curator: curate(reflector_output, playbook_id)
        Curator-->>Cycle: CuratorOutput
        Cycle->>Playbook: apply_delta(playbook_id, delta_bullets)
    end

    Cycle->>Logger: log_tdd_cycle(...)
    Cycle-->>Runner: CycleResult
    Runner->>Runner: check completeness / max iterations
    alt not complete and not max iterations
        Runner->>Planner: next_increment(...)
    else complete or max reached
        Runner-->>Runner: return IterativeResult
    end
```
